Join us in this role where you’ll support our enterprise architects in developing the foundations that guide Ørsted’s technology choices while working under the mentorship of experienced architecture professionals.

You’ll help maintain architectural materials, prepare clear communication, and support our architecture communities while learning how technology and business strategy come together in practice.

**Welcome to AI, Data & Architecture

**You’ll be part of Enterprise Architecture, where you, together with a team of enterprise architects will help develop and communicate target architectures, technology roadmaps, architectural principles, and governance. You'll work across the organisation and learn from experienced specialists whose work helps guide Ørsted’s future use of technologies and platforms.

As a team, we share knowledge, welcome different perspectives, and help each other turn complex topics into clear and practical solutions. We value curiosity, constructive dialogue, and a good sense of humour.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• refining storylines and key messages for management, making complex information clear and concise

• updating and maintaining architectural materials, including the technology selection process, buy-versus-build framework, and business capability overview

• developing training materials for AI initiatives

• coordinating communications for our platform and architecture communities, including newsletters, knowledge sessions, announcements, and events

• participating in meetings and knowledge-sharing activities and using feedback to develop your work

• supporting the reuse, simplification, and selection of sustainable technology solutions across the organisation.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in digital technology, international business, technology management, business and IT, computer science, or a related field, or have equivalent experience

• Are curious, eager to learn and thrive in a dynamic business environment

• have a strong interest in the intersection between technology and business strategy and are keen to learn more about enterprise architecture

• bring a structured and analytical approach and enjoy turning complex information into clear insights

• communicate clearly in writing and conversation

• take ownership of your tasks while asking for input and feedback when needed

• enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, and contributing to an open and inclusive team.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be reviewing applications and conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

At Ørsted, we’re committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is 165 DKK bachelor/ 185 DKK master for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated salary range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. This job ad is primarily aimed at candidates earlier in their career or still developing experience within the field, so we anticipate the starting base salary will typically fall in the lower end of the stated range. However, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of experience level. Where applicable, the position may also include variable pay and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

SAS is expanding! We are pleased to announce that applications are now open for our Fall 2026 Cabin Crew courses.

SAS is expanding - connecting people, cultures, and destinations like never before, and inviting you to be part of it.

We are now looking for more colleagues who want to be a part of this journey.

As part of the SAS Cabin Crew team, you will meet people from all around the world. You will take pride in creating a safe and welcoming experience for Scandinavia’s travelers by ensuring onboard safety, delivering great service and sales on SAS flights. The role involves varying schedules, requiring a high level of flexibility and adaptability in your day-to-day work.

SAS believes that diversity makes the team stronger. By working together, SAS fosters an inclusive workplace where everyone can feel valued and where every journey and every person matter.

Minimum Requirements

• 
Minimum age 18 years.

• 
Height at least 160 cm (without shoes).

• 
Completed education to a minimum level of high school or equivalent level.

• 
Minimum 2 years of work experience in a customer-facing role. Hospitality, sales and service experience is considered an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English language (Berlitz level B2/gym. Min. B).

• 
Strong swimming skills.

• 
Able to comply with uniform regulations: Visible tattoos are allowed below the neck, excluding hands and chest. One small, discreet tattoo, no larger than 1,5cm is, however, acceptable on the hand and right behind the ear (not extending onto back of head or neck). Visible tattoos should not be offensive or religious motives.

• 
Valid EU passport allowing free travel worldwide.

• 
Eligible to live and work permanently in Denmark.

• 
You must be available to work scheduled shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

• 
Able to get to Copenhagen Kastrup Airport (CPH) within 1h and 20 min on standby duties.

Addition requirements for experienced Cabin Crew

• 
Valid EASA Attestation and Medical.

• 
Minimum of one year of continuous experience as Senior Cabin Crew, within the past five years.

Security & Medical Requirements

• 
Employment requires an approved Security Assessment which includes security interview, 5-year-background check, reference check and exhaustive police certificate/clean record.

• 
Approved/passed training course, and that you meet the company’s requirements set for cabin crew.

• 
Good physical and mental health, as well as good vision (+/- 0.7 with or without corrections). Can be health approved according to EASA Regulations. To read more about medical certification for Cabin Crew, click here.

• 
Employment also requires completed and passed drug and alcohol tests (blood and urine samples).

• 
Our premises and work are located within the airport security-related area; therefore you must be approved by the aviation authorities.

• 
All the steps above must be approved before commencing the Cabin Crew training.

**Personal Qualities
**You are someone who:

• 
Has a strong service mindset and connects naturally with people through strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• 
Contributes to a safe, efficient, and welcoming onboard environment on every flight.

• 
Maintain a professional, calm, and solution-oriented attitude in all situations.

• 
Are a strong team player and adaptable, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

• 
Resilient and can manage irregular hours and changing schedules.

**

SAS Culture**

At Scandinavian Airlines, the focus is on caring for people, delivering exceptional experiences for travelers, and advancing the transition toward more sustainable aviation. This is guided by the iCARE framework, reflecting a commitment to Inspiration, Collaboration, Accountability, Recognition, and Execution in everything they do.

As a future team member, candidates can expect to be part of a collaborative environment where shared goals drive performance, contributions are recognized, and successes are celebrated. The organization places strong emphasis on safe, sustainable, and punctual operations, while actively working to reduce environmental impact and transform for the future

SAS is proud to operate through three owned subsidiaries; SAS Scandinavia, SAS Connect and SAS Link. We are excited to offer exciting career opportunities, including permanent positions and employment in 100%, 80% and 0% Resource pool. Although you might have a preference, we always give the option of the available position we have at the time.

If you meet the above qualifications and would like to join SAS Cabin Crew team, we encourage you to submit your application by clicking “Apply Now”.

Recruitment will take place based on operational needs. The first courses are planned for fall and winter 2026/2027. Due to high number of applications, response time may be longer than usual. You are always welcome to contact us at cc@aapaviation.com.

Our Recruitment Journey

• 
Application and online assessment: You will complete a set of application questions along with a video introduction where you have the chance to showcase yourself and to stand out. Once submitted, we will review your skills and experience.

• 
Assessment Center: If your application is successful, the next step will be an invitation to attend our assessment day.

• 
Post Assessment: Before employment can be offered you will need to complete various checks including reference checks, criminal record checks and security clearance.

• 
Pre-employment checks: Successful candidates will need to complete a medical examination and drug- and alcohol test.

• 
Cabin Crew Training: If you have passed all the requirements, you can start our 4-week Cabin Crew training program which will prepare you for a career in the sky.

consultative sales or market experience including strategic selling and negotiation in a complex sales environment involving multiple decisionmakers/ influencers.

Excellent Danish and English language skills.

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable. The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

• 
Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• 
Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• 
Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• 
Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• 
Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

• 
Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• 
Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• 
Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• 
Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

• 
Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• 
Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• 
Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• 
Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.

As Marketing Manager, Nordics, you will be responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy and annual marketing plan for one of our business channels across the Nordic region, in line with company objectives, regional priorities, and global strategy.

You will play a key role in accelerating business growth by identifying market opportunities, driving customer engagement, strengthening customer adoption, and delivering impactful marketing initiatives that support our commercial objectives.

Working closely with commercial, clinical, and regional marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into effective marketing programs that drive customer success and long-term business performance.

You will report to the Senior Marketing Manager, Nordics and be based in Copenhagen, with regular travel across the Nordic region.

Role expectations

Strategic Growth & Business Development

• Lead the strategic growth of your assigned business channel across the Nordics by identifying and executing high-impact growth opportunities in alignment with EMEA strategy and in close collaboration with the commercial organization and Senior Marketing Manager.

• Proactively represents the Nordic region and our customers by providing market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and business analytics to support new product development and global strategy.

• Identify local growth opportunities and champion initiatives that support business expansion beyond regional marketing plans.

• Focus on end-to-end excellence across products, services, and customer experiences while maintaining a broad market perspective and identifying future opportunities.

• Generate actionable customer, market, and competitive insights to shape commercial priorities and marketing investments.

Marketing Planning & Execution

• Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for the assigned business channel, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, company strategy, regional priorities, and global direction.

• Lead and execute channel marketing initiatives, including congresses, summits, customer events, speaker programs, educational activities, marketing playbooks, digital campaigns, and customer engagement programs.

• Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of key initiatives by defining timelines, responsibilities, materials, agency deliverables, stakeholder briefings, field team alignment, attendance where relevant, and post-activity follow-up.

• Champion regional and central marketing programs locally in close collaboration with sales, clinical, and regional teams, ensuring activities are translated into clear and practical execution for the Nordic markets.

• Use analytics and insights, including campaign ROI, customer reimbursement trends, market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback, to continuously optimize marketing performance and improve future activities.

• Support successful product launches, commercialization strategies, and customer adoption initiatives.

KOL & Customer Engagement

• Build and maintain strong relationships with KOLs, speakers, key customers, institutions, and professional associations across the Nordics.

• Partner with external stakeholders to deliver educational, scientific, and professional initiatives that strengthen customer engagement and thought leadership.

• Identify, brief, and support speakers and KOLs for congresses, educational programs, and customer-facing activities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner closely with Commercial, Clinical, Finance, Education, Regional Marketing, and local country teams to ensure aligned execution and measurable business impact.

• Provide channel expertise, customer insights, campaign materials, messaging, and practical guidance to support successful local execution.

• Build stakeholder alignment across functions and markets to drive implementation of strategic initiatives.

Digital Marketing & Innovation

• Utilize digital communication platforms, marketing technologies, AI-enabled tools, automation solutions, and analytics platforms to deliver and optimize marketing activities.

• Deliver integrated omnichannel campaigns that enhance customer engagement throughout the customer journey building the future of Digital dentistry.

• Explore innovative approaches to customer engagement and continuously evaluate emerging marketing trends and leverage EMEA and global best practices

Training & Capability Building (consider erasing – repetition)

• Train and educate country stakeholders on relevant aspects of the business channel, customer journey, brand strategy, products, and marketing initiatives.

• Develop training materials and supporting collateral to enable effective execution across local teams and share best practices, customer insights, and market learnings to support continuous improvement across the Nordic organization.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 4+ years of relevant experience in B2B or healthcare marketing, preferably within the medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or Fast-Moving Consumer Healthcare (FMCH) industries.

• Demonstrated experience developing and implementing successful marketing strategies and campaigns.

• Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, clinical, and field-based teams.

• Experience managing agencies, events, and external partners.

• Proven ability to use data and insights to drive decision-making and business results.

• Hands-on experience with congress participation, event execution, agency coordination, customer-facing activities, digital campaigns, marketing materials, and follow-up processes.

Skills

• Strong strategic mindset and commercial acumen.

• Ability to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into actionable initiatives.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

• Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.

• Ability to work independently and navigate a matrix organization.

• Comfortable balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.

• Proactive problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.

• Results-oriented and customer-focused approach.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

**

Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline is required; a Master’s degree is considered an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

• Fluent in English.

• Fluent in Danish or Swedish.

Scientific Software Engineer for Research Software Engineering Group

The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of Europe’s largest research infrastructure projects and is building the world’s most powerful neutron source. Through cutting-edge science and technology, ESS will enable discoveries that advance our understanding of materials, energy, health, and the environment.

About the role

The Research Software Engineering (RSE) group develops and maintains critical software systems that make neutron scattering experiments at ESS possible and successful.

As a Scientific Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of key platforms supporting the scientific user journey, including the ESS User Portal, metadata catalogue, electronic notebook, and related scientific information systems. You will work closely with scientists, software engineers, and stakeholders across ESS to gather requirements, understand user needs, and develop robust software solutions that integrate seamlessly with the wider ESS ecosystem.

The RSE group uses modern web technologies and software engineering practices to deliver high-quality software with a long operational lifetime. In addition, the group is expanding its focus on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions that can enhance the scientific user experience. As part of this effort, you will contribute to new AI-related initiatives and help establish RSE as a centre of expertise and development for AI applications within the Science Directorate.

This position is well suited for an experienced software engineer with a strong technical foundation, excellent collaboration skills, and a passion for building software that enables world-class scientific research.

Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain software systems supporting the scientific user journey at ESS.

• Contribute to the development of the ESS User Portal, metadata catalogue, electronic notebook, and related scientific information management systems.

• Gather, analyse, and refine requirements from scientific and technical stakeholders across ESS.

• Design and implement integrations between RSE applications and other ESS services and platforms.

• Apply modern software engineering practices to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software solutions.

• Contribute to technical and process improvements within the SIMS group.

• Participate in AI and Machine Learning initiatives supporting the Science Directorate.

• Collaborate with scientists, software engineers, and international partners to develop innovative solutions for scientific computing and data management.

• Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the team when appropriate.

• Contribute to software architecture discussions and technology decisions within the group.

Required qualifications

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Typically 4-7 years of relevant professional experience in software development.

• Experience developing modern web applications and services.

• Strong programming skills and experience with modern software development practices.

• Experience gathering requirements and working directly with stakeholders and end users.

• Experience designing and implementing integrations between complex software systems.

• Ability to work independently and manage technical tasks and projects with limited supervision.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Desirable qualifications

• Experience working with scientific software, research infrastructures, or data-intensive environments.

• Experience with cloud-based services and distributed systems.

• Experience with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies and their practical application.

To support the growth of Genmab, we are looking for a Manager, Reverse logistics to join the team in Copenhagen.

As Manager, Reverse Logistics & Compliance you will develop and manage global reverse logistics processes across Genmab’s distribution network in the US, EU and APAC.

The role covers product returns, recall logistics, expired and damaged inventory, and product destruction, ensuring traceability, inventory accuracy and effective coordination with Quality, Finance and relevant compliance functions.

You will also coordinate compliance across global supply chain activities, working closely with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Trade Compliance, Legal and Finance to embed applicable regulatory requirements and internal controls into operational processes. This includes supporting compliance risk assessments, audit readiness, corrective actions and training, while promoting clear accountability and continuous improvement across supply chain teams and external partners.

The role reports to Director, Head of Corporate Logistics & Distribution, Commercial Supply Chain

Responsibilities

• Global reverse logistics: Establish and manage processes for return authorization, collection, transportation, receipt, segregation, inventory reconciliation and final disposition, including associated documentation and financial closure.

• Returns management: Coordinate commercial returns with 3PLs, distributors and regional teams, ensuring product eligibility, batch details, quantities, condition and supporting documentation are verified.

• Recall and withdrawal support: Lead supply chain execution of recalls and market withdrawals under the relevant governance, including collection, shipment tracking, reconciliation and operational support for mock recalls.

• Product disposition and destruction: Coordinate the execution of Quality-approved disposition decisions, including return to saleable inventory where permitted, continued quarantine or destruction. Ensure destruction is documented and reconciled with inventory and financial records.

• Traceability and systems: Maintain accurate physical and system inventory records throughout the returns lifecycle. Coordinate with IT and serialization teams on applicable product verification, serialization and traceability activities.

• Financial and trade coordination: Work with Finance, Commercial/Trade and Trade Compliance to align returns with credit processing, inventory write-offs, SOX controls and applicable customs, VAT and duty requirements.

• Performance and improvement: Develop a global scorecard covering return cycle time, reconciliation accuracy, destruction completion, supplier performance, compliance issues and cost. Lead improvements that reduce waste and strengthen process control.

• Supply chain compliance governance: Establish and maintain a global supply chain compliance framework across the US, EU and APAC, coordinating with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Trade Compliance, Legal and Finance to embed applicable requirements into supply chain processes.

• Compliance monitoring and remediation: Coordinate supply chain compliance risk assessments, monitor adherence to approved procedures and internal controls, and drive timely closure of, Quality events, assigned audit findings and corrective actions with accountable functions.

• Change assessment and training: Partner with Quality and compliance functions to assess the supply chain impact of regulatory and operational changes, translate agreed requirements into procedures and controls, and coordinate training for internal teams and external partners.

• Management of stakeholders: Corporate and Regional Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Trade Compliance, Legal, Finance, Commercial/Trade, Procurement, IT and serialization teams, alongside 3PLs, distributors, transportation providers and authorized destruction partners.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Life Sciences, Business Administration or a related discipline.

• Typically five or more years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology logistics, distribution or supply chain operations.

• Experience managing product returns, recalls, inventory reconciliation and destruction within a regulated environment.

• Working knowledge of GDP/GxP principles, temperature-controlled distribution and pharmaceutical product traceability.

• Familiarity with ERP and warehouse management systems, preferably SAP, and operational reporting tools.

• Experience supporting supplier oversight, deviations, corrective actions, audits and controlled documentation.

• Experience in supply chain compliance within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including working knowledge of GxP/GDP, trade compliance and SOX/internal controls.

• Demonstrated ability to conduct compliance risk assessments, support audits and inspections, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions across supply chain functions.

Skills and capabilities

• Strong cross-functional coordination and the ability to influence without direct authority.

• Structured approach to problem-solving, documentation and follow-through.

• Ability to establish global standards and adapt execution to regional requirements.

• Sound judgment when escalating quality, compliance or business risks.

Own the code side of the design standard with a small team, so design intent survives the trip into production.

• 
Push back when a design won't hold up in code - too many states, no empty case, a pattern that already exists - and say what you'd do instead.

• 
Work with PMs, designers, and engineers across product teams, and bring them ideas before they ask.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

• 
You have 5+ years of frontend experience in B2B SaaS, including design system work.

• 
You're strong in React, TypeScript, and CSS.

• 
You have taste for craft: spacing, motion, states, and the details that make a component feel finished.

• 
You think in systems: reusable, documented, maintainable components over one-off fixes.

• 
You get from a rough idea to a working prototype fast.

• 
You own your work end to end, from discovery through testing to shipping.

• 
You care about the difference between "works" and "is right," and you'll say so and set the direction.

The interview process looks like:

• 
Short meet and greet with Lead People Partner

• 
A logical test

• 
1st interview: Meet and greet with our Senior Director of Product Design

• 
Take-home assignment

• 
2nd interview: Assignment presentation with Senior Director of Product Design and Lead Designer

And who are Famly?

You’re probably wondering at this stage, and Famly are...? Well, it all began when our co-founder Henrik’s daughter was ready to start at daycare. He couldn’t believe the amount of work being done on paper - and how distant he felt from his first child during the day. The paper ‘parent’ books they exchanged once a month just weren’t cutting it. Together with his friend, our co-founder and CEO Anders, they set about solving that.

These days, about 180 of us build Famly for more than 10,000 institutions and over 1 million parents.

We handle admin stress so they can get back to what matters, and we make it easier than ever to connect home, and nursery so parents can play a part in their child’s day. If you join us, you’ll be building, selling, or support customers with everything from staff rotas and invoices, to child development and parent communication.

How we work

Famly prides itself on a few principles; we choose simplicity, we believe friendliness is a superpower, we set the pace, and we want everyone to be surrounded by talent.

It all adds up to a culture that refuses to make employees choose between a place that is ambitious and sets the pace for what good looks like - and one that is a nice place to work. We think you can be ambitious and kind and when you get to meet our team, we hope you’ll agree.

What we expect of you, is that you make others shine, that you believe in being better than yesterday, and you are not afraid to just ‘get it done’. Finally, we want you to value ‘sitting in the tiny chair’ - which means you look at your work through the impact it has on our customers: the people sitting in tiny chairs in childcare settings all over the world.

What’s in it for you?

• 
Competitive pension, private health insurance, and paid maternity/paternity leave.

• 
A clear career framework and coaching to make sure you’re growing, a $1000 personal development budget and a ‘We’ll buy you any book you want’ policy.

• 
We guarantee we’ll create the time, space and leadership (as well as the budget) to make sure you grow and develop.

• 
We want to set the pace, and don't cut corners when it comes to investing in tooling and technology that you need to be at the frontier of tech.

• 
We’re all about hiring clever people who are good humans too. It means Famly is full of top thinkers and generous teammates waiting to help you shine.

• 
We like to give a lot of ownership both in terms of responsibility and freedom to try new, challenging tasks.

• 
Top-notch work equipment (including noise cancelling headphones for those focus periods!).

• 
We believe collaboration happens best in person, so we have the default of four days a week in office - but with plenty of flexibility for when life happens outside the office too.

We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible, so get your application in today by sending us:

• 
Your CV

• 
Short and precise cover letter to tell us what you can bring to the role

• 
Portfolio (attached or linked) showcasing your work

Looking forward to hearing from you!

The inside scoop on Famly

Wanna get to know Famly even better? Then have a look at our website to learn more about:

• 
our product and our mission

• 
our company and who we are

• 
our company values

• 
what it's like working at Famly

Want to get know more about how we work in Famly?

One of our builders, Matthew Fitzsimmons talking about how he, and the other builders are working with AI.

Our CEO, Anders Laustsen talking about embracing AI

Famly is committed to creating a more diverse, equal, and inclusive workforce, building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. It is a fundamental policy at Famly not to discriminate on any basis or characteristics and celebrate diversity. Everyone is welcome and encouraged to apply.

Do you want to work with the technology behind advanced supply chain planning in one of Europe’s leading retail companies? Are you motivated by solving complex challenges, working with large data sets, and helping shape the future of supply chain planning?

You will be based at our Head Office in Aarhus and become part of an experienced and collaborative team where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional development are part of our everyday work.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, you will join an international organisation where development, responsibility, and cooperation go hand in hand. We believe that committed people create the best results, which is why we provide opportunities to learn, grow, and take ownership of your work. You will become part of a skilled team working with business-critical supply chain solutions and modern technologies that support JYSK’s continued growth.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• The opportunity to work with strategic supply chain planning solutions used across the JYSK organisation

• Professional and personal development through training, knowledge sharing, and ongoing learning opportunities

• A dedicated team with a short distance from decision to action

• A modern and collaborative workplace at our Head Office in Aarhus

• Attractive staff benefits and special discounts from companies within Lars Larsen Group

• A healthy work-life balance and a company culture built on trust and responsibility

• Social activities throughout the year, including Friday bars, sporting events, and company celebrations

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You will join an experienced team of consultants that are centered in our agile team Flow of Goods Planning. The team is responsible for implementing, developing and supporting the core supply chain planning solutions in JYSK covering demand planning, supply planning, forecasting and replenishment for all JYSK distribution centers and stores.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Troubleshooting and resolving issues related to forecasting and replenishment planning processes

• Developing and maintaining data models and integration solutions between SAP S/4HANA and RELEX

• Translating business requirements into scalable technical solution designs

• Configuring and developing business rules, workflows, and functionalities in RELEX

• Creating test data, executing testing activities, and ensuring solution quality

• Collaborating with business stakeholders, vendors, and internal IT teams

• Supporting stable operations through monitoring, documentation, and 2nd and 3rd level support

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

Success in this role requires a combination of technical understanding, analytical thinking, and the ability to work across business and IT. You enjoy investigating complex issues, working with data, and creating solutions that make a measurable difference to business operations.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Holds a relevant master’s degree within Operations and Supply Chain Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related field

• Has 2-4 years of experience working with supply chain systems, integrations, or technical consulting

• Has experience working with large data sets and understands data modelling, transformation, and troubleshooting

• Has knowledge of supply chain planning processes such as forecasting and replenishment

• Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively with both technical and business stakeholders

• Brings a structured and analytical approach to solving complex technical challenges

• Has experience with RELEX, SAP environments, retail operations, consulting, or AI-related technologies, which will be considered an advantage

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader, Supply Chain Planning Solutions, Jesper Vang at +45 4174 1661.

Send us a brief application with your CV by clicking “Apply”. We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

jobs.occupation: Are you our new jewellery design intern?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a jewellery design intern to support us with design and production.

longvé is a dynamic and innovative jewellery start-up located in the heart of Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv. We offer a fresh digital approach to the jewellery industry, with our digital platform empowering customers to design their own jewellery. We offer the customers classic customisable designs, handcrafted quality and sustainable sourcing of recycled materials, all at a transparent and fair price. The company launched at the end of 2022.

We are currently seeking an intern jewellery designer. This is a unique opportunity to impact a newly launched brand, and get a steep learning curve, while working in a high-paced start-up environment, where we make sure to have fun.

Besides being enrolled in a study program within jewellery design, fashion design or something similar, the ideal candidate should have:

• Experience in Rhino software

• Knowledge of rendering in Keyshot is an advantage.

• Skilled in ideation and sketching.

• Responsibility to meet deadlines and take ownership of the project.

• Ability to work independently in a high-paced start-up environment.

• Willingness to be a part of something new and exciting.

**

What you will do:**

As an intern, you will help develop new jewellery styles and collections by sketching new designs, and drawing up designs in Rhino. You will also have the opportunity to work with our partners for translating the designs into the hands of our craftsmen, as well as preparing the right quality image material for frontline sales and marketing use.

What you get:

• Hands-on experience with building a new jewellery brand

• Insights into and experience with the start-up world

• Possibility to build up portfolio material

• Autonomous working schedule where you can influence ways of working

• Working closely with the founders and joining a team that values great energy, good humour and strong collaboration

The start date and length of the internship will be agreed with the selected candidate. The internship may lead to a potential job opportunity based on the fit, skills, and growth of the business.

We promise to give you hands-on experience as well as an exciting playground for you to test, develop and execute great ideas. If you find this an exciting opportunity, please send your CV and resume, with some examples you have done, and the style you like personally. Send to Katja Schjølin at katja@longve.com.

Do you want to helps us transform the way passengers and baggage move through airports? Do you want to play a key role in developing the high-level control software that powers the next generation automated screening solutions?
Then join us as our new Senior Software Engineer

Join BEUMER Group and Shape the Future of Airport Security
The global aviation industry is facing increasing demands for security, operational efficiency, and passenger experience. SECTRO is BEUMER Group’s strategic response to these challenges, combining advanced automation, intelligent system integration, and scalable software solutions to create the future of airport security screening. As SECTRO continues its transition from development into industrialization and execution, software has become a critical success factor in delivering a standardized, configurable, and globally scalable product portfolio.

Your Role
As our Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical authority and go-to person for High-Level Control (HLC) within SECTRO. You will be responsible for maintaining an overall overview of the HLC tools, ensuring alignment across projects and products, and driving the evolution of our software platform. The role combines technical leadership, stakeholder management, roadmap development, and hands-on execution. You will be part of a global and cross-functional engineering setup, collaborating closely with software, automation, and system engineers, as well as external partners and suppliers.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Act as the technical focal point and subject matter expert for HLC solutions across the SECTRO product portfolio.

• 
Maintain the overall overview of the HLC landscape, ensuring consistency, standardization, and scalability across projects.

• 
Drive technical decision-making and architectural direction for HLC software solutions for SECTRO.

• 
Contribute to defining and maintaining the SECTRO roadmap.

• 
Translate business needs, project requirements, and technology opportunities into actionable development initiatives.

• 
Lead the design, development, and implementation of High-Level Control software solutions.

• 
Collaborate with external suppliers and technology partners to ensure seamless integration.

• 
Support project teams with expert guidance throughout design, implementation, commissioning, and operational phases.

Technology Stack

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will get the chance to work with the following Tech-stack:

• 
Microservice-based architecture

• 
C# 14+

• 
.NET 10 and ASP.NET Core

• 
REST APIs and service-oriented integrations

• 
Docker and Kubernetes

• 
CI/CD using GitLab and Helm Charts

• 
Git and GitLab source control management

• 
Distributed systems and cloud-native design principles

• 
SQL-based data management and configuration handling

• 
Integration with industrial automation platforms and High-Level Control systems

What You Bring

We imagine you a degree withing Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or related technical field and have extensive experience within complex industrial, logistics, automation, or mission-critical environments.

Moreover we expect you to have:

• 
Knowledge of software architecture, system integration, and interface design.

• 
Experience with High-Level Control systems, distributed software platforms, or similar solutions.

• 
Proven ability to drive technical direction and coordinate activities across global and multidisciplinary teams.

• 
Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.

• 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• 
A proactive mindset with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

You are fluent both in both written and spoken English.

Interested?
If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact TPO & Team Manager, SECTRO Christian Kjer Elkjær at +45 3176 7183 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Vestergaard Holm at +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group
Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a work culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

• 
We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

• 
During our immersive onboarding program in, you will receive an extensive overview of BEUMER Group, our history, and our vision for the future, whilst also getting to know your new colleagues.

• 
Through a culture of open feedback, transparent corporate updates, and regular employee events, we actively cultivate a friendly, open, and collaborative working environment

• 
Your personal and professional growth is integral to our ethos. We champion your development through a wide range of training courses and upskilling opportunities — including support for external courses and grants for trainees.

• 
Flexible working hours and the choice of operating from a remote office are important components of our modern work culture, much like our bright, spacious offices and ergonomically optimized workstations.

• 
Your health matters to us. Enjoy free access to our on-site fitness centre and join one of our many sports clubs for a healthier, more connected work-life. We also provide computer glasses subsidies, vegetarian lunch options, and free fresh fruit to help boost your well-being.

• 
You will get access to Denmark’s largest discount portal, and receive exclusive discounts and promotional offers from a wide-range of companies and businesses.

• 
From accident insurance to attractive company pension schemes and health insurance for you and your children, we are committed to supporting your long-term well-being.

• 
Supporting you when you are not in work is also important to us. Our Staff Association organizes and sponsors social, cultural, and sporting activities, including our annual Christmas and Summer parties, which are always great fun.

• 
Sustainability is one of our key core values, which we tackle on multiple fronts. For example, you will have access to our electric charging stations in the employee parking area, with the electricity being provided at cost price.

• 
Fair pay is extended to all our employees, and we ensure we provide a balanced and equitable remuneration framework. You will also receive a number of additional salary benefits that combine to form an attractive salary package.

• 
Everyone needs a rest and a break from work at some point. That is why you will receive 30 days of vacation days per year, as well as various other special holiday days. We also provide extra support for maternity and paternity leave.
